sources.text:

Audio recorders can be reserved through the equipment calendar. A reservation is provisional until the
coordinator confirms it by email. Each pair may borrow one recorder for three days. Collect it from the east office
between 10:00 and 15:00 on a weekday, and check the battery before leaving. Borrowers must return the
recorder to the same office before noon on the fourth day. If that office is closed, contact the coordinator; do not
leave equipment outside the door.

coordinator using the participant code, without putting names in the email subject. Later requests will be
considered individually.

Keep the original train ticket receipts and write the visit date on the back. Reimbursement covers the least
expensive reasonable public transport route, up to 2400 yen per person for each visit. Taxi fares require written
approval before the journey. Submit the expense form within ten calendar days of the visit, with the receipts
attached. Missing receipts cannot be replaced by a bank statement. Ask the office before paying for any unusual
travel arrangement.

Submit the fieldwork report as a PDF by Wednesday at 18:00. The report should contain a question, a description
of the method, a short analysis and a reflection. Keep the main text between 1200 and 1600 words; references do
not count toward this limit. Include the participant codes in quotations, and remove names and contact
information. A late report needs an extension agreed before the original deadline. Sending a message after the
deadline does not automatically create an extension.

rows.query: スタジオの予約はいつまで無料で変更できますか？その後の料金は？

sources.text:
Changing a booking
A studio booking can be changed without a fee until 17:00 on the preceding day. Open the original confirmation
message and use its change link. Changes after this deadline cost 500 yen unless the building has been closed
by the operator. A different participant cannot take over the booking without written approval. When cancelling a
group booking, tell the other members yourself; the system sends the confirmation only to the original organiser.

Using the shared studio
The studio is a shared workspace for workshops and independent practice. A booking reserves a work area, not
exclusive use of the entire room. Keep conversations quiet when another group is recording. Personal belongings
should stay under the table rather than in the corridor. The last group of the day checks the windows and
switches off the lights. Report damaged furniture through the maintenance form so that the next group does not
have to discover the problem.

Reserving a recorder
Audio recorders can be reserved through the equipment calendar. A reservation is provisional until the
coordinator confirms it by email. Each pair may borrow one recorder for three days. Collect it from the east office
between 10:00 and 15:00 on a weekday, and check the battery before leaving. Borrowers must return the
recorder to the same office before noon on the fourth day. If that office is closed, contact the coordinator; do not
leave equipment outside the door.

。

理。如需他人代领，请提前发送授权邮件，并写明代领人的姓名。超过三天仍未领取的作品，请先联系工作人员确
认保管位置，不要直接进入储藏室寻找。

活动安排
本工作坊面向希望尝试手工制作的初学者。上午先介绍工具的使用方法，再由参与者独立完成练习。讲师示范时请
把手中的工具放在桌面上，以便看清步骤。如果没有听懂，可以请讲师放慢速度或再次演示。下午的制作可以根据
个人进度调整，不要求所有人同时完成。活动最后会安排交流时间，请介绍自己尝试的方法以及制作过程中遇到的
困难。这里重视练习与分享，不进行作品排名。

Finished work
Allow printed fabric to dry on the marked rack before packing it. Collect finished work within seven days of the
workshop. Small items are kept in the numbered blue boxes; large items are stored behind the screen. Reception
is open from 11:00 to 16:00, Tuesday through Saturday. Bring the collection slip, or send written permission if
someone else will collect the work. After seven days, contact reception to arrange storage rather than assuming
the item is still on the rack.

更改与取消
如果无法参加，请尽早通过报名确认邮件中的链接取消。活动开始四十八小时以前取消，可以退还全部报名费；之
后取消不退款，但可以申请把名额转给一位朋友。转让必须在活动前一天的下午四点以前由工作人员确认，不能在
签到时临时更换。若活动因主办方原因取消，会主动通知报名者，并说明退款安排。交通延误导致迟到时，请发邮
件告知预计到达时间，不需要重新报名。

作品保管
刚完成的作品需要在晾干架上放置至少三十分钟，确认表面干燥后才能装袋。不能当天带走的作品可以免费保管三
天。请在作品背面贴上报名编号，不要只写名字。领取时携带报名确认邮件，在下午两点到五点之间到一楼前台办
理。如需他人代领，请提前发送授权邮件，并写明代领人的姓名。超过三天仍未领取的作品，请先联系工作人员确
认保管位置，不要直接进入储藏室寻找。

材料与费用
报名费用包含基础纸张、颜料和现场工具的使用，不包含额外的木框。需要木框的参加者可以在签到时选择购买，
每个八百日元。购买前请先确认尺寸，开封后不能退换。工具只限在教室内使用，不能带回家。如果中途发现材料
不足，请向助教领取，不要自行打开储藏柜。活动结束时，剩余的普通纸张可以带走；未使用的专用材料要放回指
定的回收盒，供下一次课程使用。
